about_the_game:
"Don't hate the media, become the media."

Punk's not dead. Stand up and stand out on the streets of San Francisco with this patchwork pack of DIY-themed gear. And remember, if it's good enough for The Wrench...

This pack includes:
- Full Punk Rock outfit for Marcus
- Punk Rock skin for Marcus' weapon
- Punk Rock skin for Marcus' drone
- Punk rock skin for Marcus' car
